# Detroit Fight Company

> Combat sports academy in Winter Springs, Florida, offering Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (gi and no gi), boxing, Muay Thai, MMA, and sparring for adults, plus Youth Jiu-Jitsu and Youth Boxing for kids. Head Coach and owner: IBJJF black belt Sean Goolsby. Free trial class available.
> His IBJJF results are listed at https://detroitfight.com/competition-team.
> Founded by Sean Goolsby in Jacareí, São Paulo, Brazil, in 2023. Relocated to Winter Springs, Florida, in March 2026.

## Location
1425 Tuskawilla Rd #209, Winter Springs, FL 32708. Serves Winter Springs, Oviedo, Casselberry, Winter Park, Seminole County, and greater Orlando.
Drive times: about 15 minutes from Oviedo and Casselberry, about 20 from Winter Park, Lake Mary, Longwood and Altamonte Springs, about 25 from Sanford.

## Hours
- Monday and Wednesday: 6:00 AM to 8:30 PM
- Tuesday, Thursday and Friday: 10:00 AM to 8:30 PM
- Saturday: 10:00 AM to 12:30 PM
- Sunday: Closed

## Programs
- Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu: gi, no gi, open mat, early morning
- Boxing and conditioning, including a 10:00 AM class Monday through Saturday
- Muay Thai
- MMA
- Sparring
- Kids: Kids No Gi Jiu-Jitsu and Youth Boxing after school, ages 5 to 14
- Homeschool families: the 10:00 AM boxing class is on the schedule; Jiu-Jitsu daytime sessions and group visits are arranged on request

## Pricing
- All Access Membership: $199 per month, unlimited classes in Gi and No Gi Jiu-Jitsu, Boxing, Muay Thai, MMA and open mat.
- Month to Month: $199 per month plus a one time $150 Enrollment Kit (gi and rash guard). No contract, 30 days written notice to cancel.
- 3 Month Commit: $599 paid at signup covers three months and includes the Enrollment Kit, then $199 per month.
- Family: 10% off the monthly rate for each additional household member.
- Free trial class: https://detroitfight.com/free-trial
- Private lessons with Head Coach Sean Goolsby, 60 minutes each, packs valid six months: members $120 per session, $550 for 5, $1,000 for 10; guests $200 per session, $750 for 5, $1,250 for 10. https://detroitfight.com/private-lessons
- Full details: https://detroitfight.com/pricing

## Weekly class schedule
- Monday: BJJ 6:00-7:00 AM; Boxing 10:00-11:00 AM; Youth Boxing 4:30-5:30 PM; Youth Jiu-Jitsu 4:45-5:45 PM; Boxing 5:30-6:30 PM; BJJ 6:00-7:30 PM; Boxing 6:45-7:45 PM; Muay Thai 7:30-8:30 PM
- Tuesday: Boxing 10:00-11:00 AM; Youth Jiu-Jitsu 4:45-5:45 PM; Boxing 5:30-6:30 PM; BJJ 6:00-7:30 PM; Boxing 6:45-7:45 PM; MMA 7:30-8:30 PM
- Wednesday: same as Monday
- Thursday: same as Tuesday
- Friday: Boxing 10:00-11:00 AM; Youth Boxing 4:30-5:30 PM; Youth Jiu-Jitsu 4:45-5:45 PM; Boxing 5:30-6:30 PM; BJJ 6:00-7:30 PM; Boxing 6:45-7:45 PM; Sparring 7:00-8:30 PM
- Saturday: Boxing 10:00-11:00 AM; Youth Jiu-Jitsu 10:00-11:00 AM; BJJ 11:00 AM-12:30 PM
- The live schedule at https://detroitfight.com/schedule is always current.
